findings.summary: sequence.concurrent:false only disables in-file concurrency; integration files still run in parallel workers, risking testcontainer host-port collisions
findings.suggested_fix: Add `fileParallelism: false` (or `poolOptions: { threads: { singleThread: true } }`) at the same level as sequence so testcontainer-per-file integration tests serialize across files as the task brief intends.

findings.summary: lint script `biome check src` excludes apps/api/test, drizzle.config.ts, and vitest configs from workspace-scoped lint
findings.suggested_fix: Broaden to `biome check src test *.ts` (or `biome check .`) so wave-10 test files and root-level configs are linted by `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api lint`.

findings.summary: include `src/**/*.ts` and rootDir `src` mean drizzle.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, vitest.integration.config.ts are not type-checked by `pnpm typecheck`
findings.suggested_fix: Either add an `include` entry for the root-level config files or add a separate `tsconfig.tools.json` and reference it from `typecheck` so config drift surfaces at typecheck time, not at tool invocation.

findings.summary: devDependency `tsx` added; not in task description's enumerated devDeps but justified by the required `dev: tsx watch src/main.ts` script
findings.suggested_fix: Acknowledge in task brief that `tsx` is required to run `dev`. No code change needed.
